documentType.description: Type of authorization document. ChangeOfEnergySupplierForOrganization: change of energy supplier on existing metering points. MoveInAndChangeOfEnergySupplierForOrganization: move-in combined with a change of energy supplier. EnergySupplierFrameworkAgreement: framework agreement between the energy supplier and the customer, resulting in a persistent grant.

status.description: Status of the document. Pending: awaiting the signed document. Approved: the signed document has been submitted. Expired: validTo passed before the signed document was submitted.

requestedScopes.description: Scopes requested for the authorization grant created when the document is signed.

externalReference.description: The caller's own reference, returned unchanged.

requestedGrantValidFrom.description: Requested start of validity for the authorization grant created when the document is signed. Only used for EnergySupplierFrameworkAgreement.

requestedGrantValidTo.description: Requested end of validity for the authorization grant created when the document is signed. Only used for EnergySupplierFrameworkAgreement.

requestedPrincipal.description: Identifier of the agent the authorization concerns, for example the owner of the metering point. The resolved agent becomes requestedPrincipal on the document.

requestedOf.description: Identifier of the agent asked to sign the document. The resolved agent becomes requestedOf on the document.

language.description: Language of the authorization text in the generated document.
